_doc: docs/CONCEPTS.md §4 - what counts as a substitute. Loaded by src/pricing/substituteRules.js. Patterns run against normalizeText(name): lowercase, final letters folded (ך→כ, ם→מ, ן→נ, ף→פ, ץ→צ), punctuation stripped - write regular forms only.

families._doc: A MISSING line whose concept has no candidate at the chain may borrow from its concept's family (Naor 12.10: 'כשאין מוצר מאותו עלה ברשת, להציע מהמשפחה עם הסתייגות מאותה משפחה'), always with the caveat other-family and never auto-applied. The families are the concept tree's (config/concepts family / families.json prefixes, src/catalog/concepts.js families(); cartBackend reads them from products' conceptFamily) - this block only takes away. Key = family id, or id@category when one id names families in two departments. { substitutes: false } = the family mixes things a shopper would not swap; { without: [conceptIds] } = those leaves stay out. Measured 12.10 (docs/CONCEPTS.md §4): every family whose products span two departments, plus the 40 largest by eye. Fresh/frozen twins are kept apart by the engine itself (concept ids), not here.

wine.why: red/white/rose/sparkling - and the still wines are policy none

disposable.why: cups, plates, cutlery, bowls, trays - different items

chocolate.why: bars, filled snacks, gift boxes, baking chips; and (dairy) mousse vs chocolate milk

skin.why: face cream, eye cream, hand cream, serum, mask

tea.why: black, green, herbal - the kind is the purchase

hair.why: colour, cream, serum, brush, clipper; (toiletries) mask, removal cream, gel, wax

body.why: shower gel is not body lotion

chicken.why: cuts (breast, liver, wings); (deli) sausages, nuggets, meatballs

salmon.why: whole fish vs portions vs cuts

coffee.why: instant, Turkish, beans, ground - different preparation

milk.why: fresh, UHT, goat, lactose-free, dulce de leche, flavoured drinks

yellow-cheese.why: the leaves are the form split (sliced / grated / block), which Naor ruled out on 22.9

cream.why: cream cheese, sweet cream and pasta sauces share the prefix (dairy review)

soy.why: soy drink vs soy spread (dairy review)

instant.why: noodles, mashed potato, mac and cheese

flour.why: chickpea, almond, coconut, corn flour are not white flour

baking.why: baking powder, mixes, soda, extracts; (household) baking paper, cups, trays

seeds.why: sunflower vs pumpkin vs watermelon seeds

herb.why: parsley is not cilantro; oregano is not rosemary

pickled.why: pickles, pickled mushrooms, peppers, ginger, cabbage

seasoning.why: seasoning for rice is not for steak

stuffed-vegetables.why: stuffed pepper vs zucchini vs cabbage

sausage.why: merguez, wiener, chorizo, servelat - and a vegan cocktail sausage sat in the leaf (12.10 sample)

dishwasher.why: tablets, gel, salt, rinse aid, cleaner

cloth.why: floor vs general vs disinfecting cloths

plate.why: the plate size is the purchase; (home) melamine vs glass

vitamin.why: vitamin C is not vitamin D

baby.why: formula stages (policy none), puree, nipples, wipes, teethers

babycare.why: rash cream, oil, talc, changing pad

rice@שימורים.why: white / basmati / jasmine / brown stand in; puffed rice and rice paper do not

pasta.why: spaghetti and penne stand in for each other; the sauce is not pasta, and pasta-other still holds lasagna sheets (12.10 sample: lasagna offered for penne) - rejoin it once lasagna has its own leaf

tomato@שימורים.why: crushed / diced / peeled / puree stand in for cooking; paste, sun-dried and pickled do not

oil.why: the neutral frying oils (canola, sunflower, corn) stand in; olive and the speciality oils do not

crackers.why: rice / corn / legume rice-cakes stand in; crackers are another product

potato-chip-snack.why: plain and seasoned potato chips stand in; sweet-potato chips and shaped potato snacks do not (12.10 sample: teddy-bear snack offered for sweet-potato chips)

yogurt.why: plain and natural yogurt are one shelf (12.10 sample: white bio 3% 8-pack for white bio 3% 8-pack); drinks, goat/sheep, protein and flavoured cups are not

candy.why: the gummies stand in for each other (banana gummies for banana gummy shapes); the rest of the candy shelf - hard candy, lollipops, liquorice, surprise eggs, sprinkles - does not

conceptPolicy._doc: full (default): offered both as 'cheaper' on an available line and for a missing line. missingOnly: the concept is a shelf, not a product (96 cookies from 33 brands) - offered only when the line is missing at the chain. none: never offered (incompatible systems, sizes the name carries, personal/medical).

form._doc: Physical form of a food. Both names must carry the same set - grated is not sliced, frozen is not fresh. Applied to food categories only (a 'dry hair' shampoo is not dried).

diet._doc: Dietary variants. Both names must carry the same set: lactose-free milk is never replaced by regular milk, nor the other way round. Patterns are written in normalized form (final letters folded: עזימ, צאנ, כבשימ) - read them that way before concluding a word is missing (3.10).

required._doc: Asymmetric: when the ORIGINAL carries one of these, the candidate must too. Empty since 23.9 - Naor: do not check kashrut at all (the mehadrin group was here; the mechanism stays for a future group).

variant._doc: Flavours, fillings and kinds that make two products of one concept different things for the customer. Both names must carry the same set. Read on top of the 'בטעם X / במילוי X' phrases that src/catalog/concepts.js already strips. 'words' apply to every concept and hold only true flavours (fruit, nut, spice, sweet); 'concepts' adds words for one concept where a kind is the identity - the filling of a boureka, the species of a kebab, the colour of a grape, oil vs brine in a tuna can. A generic head noun (גבינה, צהובה, בקר) must never be global: one chain writes it and the next omits it, and that blocked gouda for gouda (audit 22.9).
